PUBLIC COMMENT
Citizens wishing to address the City Council and Successor Agency on any item on the agenda or on any matter
not on the agenda may do so at this time. State law (Government Code Section 54950 et seq.) prohibits the City
Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda .
Upon request, the City Council may, in their discretion, allow citizen participation on a specific item on the agenda
at the time the item is considered by the City Council. If you wish to address the City Council /Successor Agency
at this time, please complete a speaker's card and give it to the City Clerk prior to commencement of the City
Council meeting. Please limit your remarks to three (3) minutes.

To increase the effectiveness of the Public Comment Period, the following rules shall be followed: No person
shall make any remarks which result in disrupting, disturbing or otherwise impeding the meeting.

Pursuant to Section 54957.95 of the Government Code, the presiding member of the legislative body conducting
a meeting, or their designee, is authorized to remove, or cause the removal of, an individual for disrupting the
meeting. Any such removal will be preceded by a warning to the disruptive individual by the presiding member of
the legislative body or their designee that the individual ’s behavior is disrupting the meeting and that the
individual’s failure to promptly cease their disruptive behavior may result in their removal.

  CONSENT CALENDAR
Items under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and may be enacted by one motion. There will be
no discussion of these items unless members of the Public or City Council request specific items to be removed
from the Consent Agenda for a separate discussion. lf the item is desired to be discussed separately, it should be
the first item under Scheduled Matters.

AGENDA ITEMS AND ACTIONS
5:00 P.M. CLOSED SESSION

CALL TO ORDER Mayor Argumedo called the meeting to order at 5:06 p.m.

ROLL CALL

PUBLIC COMMENT ON CLOSED SESSION ITEMS There were no individuals to address the City Council on any Closed Session items.  

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION City Council/Successor Agency recessed to Closed Session at 5:07 p.m.

RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION City Council/Successor Agency reconvened to Open Session at 6:03 p.m.

ORAL CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT City Attorney Tapia reported on Closed Session items: 

item #1, #2, and #3A. - Staff made a presentation, direction was provided and no reportable action was taken on these items.  

Item #3.B was not discussed in the Closed Session. 

6:00 P.M. - CITY COUNCIL MEETING

CALL TO ORDER Mayor Argumedo called a regular City Council meeting to order at 6:05 p.m.

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE Deputy Director of Public Works Operations Nila led the Pledge of Allegiance

INVOCATION Councilmember Lainez offered the invocation

PUBLIC COMMENT There were no individuals wishing to address the City Council on any item within their jurisdiction.




CONSENT CALENDAR  -  Action: approve (Pass) Moved by Ivan Altamirano Councilmember Garcia asked to pull item #4 for discussion. 

Deputy Director of Public Works Operations Nila provided a brief overview of the staff report and power point presentation featuring what improvements were made.  

Councilmember Garcia moved, seconded by Councilmember Rebollo, to adopt a Resolution accepting the Basketball/Volleyball Courts Resurfacing at Various City Parks Project as complete, authorizing staff to file the Notice of Completion with the County Recorder’s Office and authorizing release of 5% retention per contract provisions.  The motion was carried by the following vote: 

AYES: Councilmembers Garcia, Lainez, Rebollo, Vice Mayor Altamirano, and Mayor Argumedo (5)

5.. Weed Abatement Program - Abatement Order Directing the Los Angeles County Agricultural Commissioners/Director of Weights and Measures to Abate Public Nuisance  -  Action: approve (Pass) Moved by Oralia Rebollo Director of Administrative Services and City Clerk Shumway provided a brief overview of the staff report.  Mayor Argumedo opened Public Hearing, Mayor Argumedo closed Public Hearing.  

CITY COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY REPORTS Councilmember Rebollo extended congratulations to the ACEs team for their performance in the tournament.

Councilmember Garcia participated in a Neighborhood Watch meeting in the Veterans Park area, emphasizing the importance of voicing concerns during such gatherings. Councilmember Garcia expressed gratitude towards the public safety staff. Regarding the Aquatics Banquet, Garcia acknowledged the challenging nature of the sport and congratulated all athletes, coaches, parents, and specifically praised Rachel for putting together an excellent banquet.

Councilmember Lainez reported that he attended the Aquatics Banquet, commending the water polo team and congratulating the ACEs for their tournament in Arizona. Councilmember Lainez also urged everyone to participate in voting.  

Vice Mayor Altamirano reported that he attended an employee service award event, expressing gratitude to the Parks and Recreation Department for organizing a remarkable ceremony. Additionally, the Vice Mayor extended belated birthday wishes to the Mayor's mother.

Mayor Argumedo expressed thanks to the Vice Mayor for attending the employee service awards banquet. The Mayor reported his attendance at the Aquatics Award Banquet, discussed the I-5 Cities Joint Powers Authority meeting, and mentioned cities' efforts to seek reimbursement from Caltrans for damages to local roads caused by improvements to the I-5 freeway. Mayor Argumedo also participated in the Neighborhood Watch meeting, acknowledging the public safety staff. He highlighted the upcoming Street Cleanup Day and encouraged participation in cleaning up the on-and off-ramp to the 710 freeway, scheduled for Saturday, April 6, from 8 to 11 am.


ADJOURNMENT Meeting adjourned at 6:25 p.m.

Meeting facilities are accessible to persons with disabilities. ln compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, notify the Office of the City Clerk at (323) 722-4805 at least 24 hours prior to the meeting.
